Description (what to test): Verify the system allows an administrator to navigate to the Scheduled tab and displays the Scheduled Emails grid when scheduled emails exist.
Verify the system displays Type, Name, Scheduled For, Recipients, and Status for each scheduled email row.
Verify the system supports pagination on the Scheduled Emails grid.
Verify the system supports searching scheduled emails using the search box on the Scheduled tab.
Verify the system supports sorting scheduled emails by each grid column (Type, Name, Scheduled For, Recipients, Status).
Verify the system does not display any filter controls on the Scheduled tab.
Verify the system provides only list view on the Scheduled tab and does not provide other view controls.
Verify the system does not display an Add New button on the Scheduled tab.
Verify the system sorts scheduled emails by Scheduled For date/time in the grid.
Verify the system shows the scheduled emails grid without Edit/Delete actions when edit/delete are restricted by configuration or permissions.
Verify the system opens a details section when an administrator clicks a scheduled email row.
Verify the system shows template selection, scheduled date, scheduled time, timezone, recipients information, and status in the scheduled email details.
Verify the system shows a template dropdown containing only enabled templates that match the scheduled email Type (User vs Submission).
Verify the system displays scheduled date using a date picker in the scheduled email details.

Activity Name: Scheduled time uses time picker + timezone
Description (what to test): Verify the system displays scheduled time using a time picker and provides a timezone selector in the scheduled email details.
Verify the system displays the correct status value in the details for the scheduled email.
Verify the system opens a scheduled email with Status = Sent in view-only mode and prevents editing any fields.
Verify the system allows editing template, scheduled date, scheduled time, and timezone for a scheduled email with Status = Scheduled.
Verify the system enforces scheduled date, scheduled time, and timezone as required fields when saving a scheduled email.
Verify the system displays Save and Delete actions when editing a scheduled email with Status = Scheduled.
Verify the system blocks saving if the selected scheduled date/time is in the past relative to current UTC time and displays an error message showing the UTC comparison.
Verify the system saves scheduled email updates when the scheduled date/time is in the future and a required timezone is selected.

Activity Name: Grid reflects updates and status recalculated
Description (what to test): Verify the system updates the Scheduled tab grid after saving edits (Scheduled For changes) and recalculates status based on the updated scheduled time.
Verify the system displays a confirmation dialog when an administrator clicks Delete for a scheduled email.
Verify the system removes the scheduled email from the sending queue after deletion is confirmed.

Activity Name: Deleted email removed from Scheduled tab
Description (what to test): Verify the system removes the scheduled email from the Scheduled tab grid after deletion is confirmed.
Verify the system displays Status = 'Scheduled' when Scheduled For is in the future relative to current time.

Activity Name: Status Sending Now at current time
Description (what to test): Verify the system displays Status = 'Sending Now' when Scheduled For matches the current time.

Activity Name: Create scheduled email from User email action
Description (what to test): Verify the system creates a scheduled email entry when an administrator schedules a User email with a future date/time (validated as future) and calls /events/{eventId}/submission/emails/{templateID}/sendCustom, and the entry appears in Scheduled tab with Type = 'User' and Status = 'Scheduled'.

Activity Name: Create scheduled email from Submission email action
Description (what to test): Verify the system creates a scheduled email entry when an administrator schedules a Submission email with a future date/time (validated as future) and calls /events/{eventId}/submission/emails/{templateID}/sendCustom, and the entry appears in Scheduled tab with Type = 'Submission' and Status = 'Scheduled'.
Verify the system displays recipients count and breakdown (Submitters, Reviewers, Committee) for scheduled email entries.

Activity Name: No view controls beyond list view
Description (what to test): Verify the system does not allow switching to any view other than list view on the Scheduled tab.
Verify the system restricts template selection to enabled templates when scheduling or editing a scheduled email.
Verify the system shows a newly created scheduled email immediately in the Scheduled tab grid and maintains sorting by scheduled date/time.
